settings.title: Lower side, for back sleepers
settings.text: A gentle curve supports the natural hollow of your neck while your head rests a little lower, so your chin doesn't push towards your chest.

settings.title: Higher side, for side sleepers

settings.title: Shoulder cut-outs
settings.text: Shaped wings make room for your shoulder and arm when you roll over, so you're not lying on a hard edge.

settings.heading: One pillow. Two heights. Every position.
settings.text: Most pillows are one shape and hope for the best. This one is built in zones, so your neck gets the right support whether you start on your back, end up on your side, or switch all night.

settings.heading: Your neck deserves [better support]
settings.text: A regular pillow sinks flat within hours and leaves your neck bent. The Blomar Cervical Pillow is shaped to keep it supported until morning.

settings.heading: Why side and back sleepers are switching to the Blomar Cervical Pillow
settings.text: The stiff neck when you sit up. The careful turn of your head before you get out of bed. If that's how most mornings start, your pillow is probably part of it. The Blomar Cervical Pillow gives you two heights, shoulder cut-outs for side sleeping and a cool, breathable cover in one contoured design, so your neck stays supported however you sleep.
settings.note: Not a medical device. Results vary by individual.

settings.title: Keeps the natural neck curve
settings.text: The raised front edge supports the curve of your neck instead of letting it sag into a flat pillow.

settings.title: Takes pressure off the shoulder
settings.text: Cut-outs on each side give your shoulder somewhere to go when you sleep on your side.

settings.title: Keeps the spine neutral
settings.text: Choosing the right height for your position helps keep your head level with the rest of your spine.

settings.heading: Designed around how your neck actually rests
settings.text: No gimmicks. Just a shape built around the way your head, neck and shoulders sit when you're lying down.
settings.note: Not a medical device. Results vary. If you have an ongoing neck condition, talk to a qualified health professional.

settings.heading: Support that moves with you
settings.text: Back, side, or somewhere in between. The two heights and shoulder cut-outs adjust to your position, not the other way round.
